notes: The possessive 'his' of 'his bloody house' is written where the phrase's single determiner stands; the rectum's article is the only determiner morpheme in the chain and, with the rectum rendered attributively and no determiner of its own, rule 29's fronting hands it the phrase's determiner slot and rule 41 gives it the possessive the ASV wrote there. Rule 18's closing sentence governs a possessive with no determiner morpheme before the word it determines, which this is not.
